profile.name: Irfan Rahim Zabidi
profile.title: Software Engineer | Certified Data Analyst Associate

hero.content:
I'm Irfan Rahim Zabidi, a dedicated Software Engineer at FCS Solutions. I specialise in building and maintaining backend systems for web applications using Python, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and clean architecture. My work also involves writing efficient SQL queries and managing databases through both raw SQL and ORM frameworks.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering from the International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM), and I'm passionate about creating impactful, tech-driven solutions that solve real-world problems.

resumeProjects.title: Dashboard for Projects Progress
resumeProjects.description: Developed a dashboard for overall project progress for the team. Created a template project timeline and progress for all projects with Excel. Used Power Apps for data collection. Visualised the overall project progress with Microsoft Power Bi.

resumeProjects.title: Fully Unstripped Removal System
resumeProjects.description: FURS is used to remove half-stripped (single arm) and unstripped gloves from the former to prevent double dip and the formation of latex marks. The objectives of this system are to 100% remove detected defect gloves such as half-stripped, unstripped, and finger leftover; to prevent double dipping from occurring; to prevent latex marks from happening; and to make 100% removal of OQI and MQI possible. The designing process is used in Solid work and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Table) for data compilation.

resumeProjects.title: Indexing Robotic Arm Set
resumeProjects.description: The objectives of installing the Indexing Robotic Arm Set System are to detect the problematic carrier set that is producing a high number of defects, to alert the factory PICs about the problematic carrier set, and to prevent the problematic carrier set from continue to create defective gloves. The designing process is used in Solid work and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Table) for data compilation.

achievements.title: Artificial Intelligence Vision Camera
bullets: Cost-saving and reduction and manpower
Successfully removed at least 40 OQI (online quality inspection) worker as for the implementation of AI Vision Camera. 1 OQI worker = RM2000/month.
In house PLC programming to save RM10 000 per line over 300+ production lines. Projected cost saving = RM 5 000000.
Lowered DPM and PSI of production thus reduced the company losses.
